# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** My Soul Nearly Poured Out to Death — God's Rescue

---

**16:1** When my soul was poured out — nearly to the point of death —
I had come to the very gates of Hades alongside the sinner.

**16:2** My soul had wandered far from the LORD God of Israel —
had not the LORD helped me with his everlasting mercy —

**16:3** I would have plunged into the sleep of death;
my soul would have been ripped away from the LORD God.

**16:4** When my soul was nearly poured out to death,
when my heart had gone far from the LORD —

**16:5** I remembered the mercy of God in all his faithful deeds;
and in his goodness he descended to me with mercy.

**16:6** I could not keep watch; I could barely think of you —
my soul was at the edge of death, my heart crushed.

**16:7** I cried out to you, O LORD,
when my soul was on the brink of perishing.

**16:8** I prayed to the LORD with everything in me;
I begged him for his mercy,

**16:9** and you heard the sound of my groan;
you pulled my soul back from death.

**16:10** My hope is in you, O LORD —
I will never, ever be put to shame.

**16:11** Keep me, O LORD, in your mercy;
let no other master ever frighten me.

**16:12** For you are my praise, you are my joy —
trust in God, for I trust in the mercies of God forever.

**16:13** I will not be afraid — who is there who could harm me?
The LORD is my guardian;
he will not let my life be destroyed.

**16:14** Praised be the LORD our God,
who rules all the earth in righteousness and justice!

**16:15** May the name of the LORD be praised forever —
for his glory endures from age to age!

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
